unit_attributes.statement: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the duties under paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.
unit_attributes.actor: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: The lead agency shall develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b).

The lead agency shall, in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan.
The lead agency shall conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.

In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.

Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years, submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, and containing such information as the Secretary shall require, including the assurances and descriptions specified in paragraphs (1) through (13).
references: part A of title IV of the Social Security Act
section 3 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act

unit_attributes.statement: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes: (A) a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to (i) the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data, (ii) the designation of a new eligible entity, or (iii) severe economic dislocation; or (B) the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.

For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.
The Secretary may prescribe procedures for the purpose of assessing the effectiveness of eligible entities in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.
The chief executive officer of each State may revise any plan prepared under this section and shall submit the revised plan to the Secretary.
unit_attributes.actor: The chief executive officer of each State
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of each State

unit_attributes.statement: Each plan or revised plan prepared under this section shall be made available for public inspection within the State in such a manner as will facilitate review of, and comment on, the plan.

For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan in accordance with the provisions of this chapter (as in effect on the day before October 27, 1998), rather than the provisions of subsections (a) through (c) relating to applications and plans.
